questions.stem: How does ADH (antidiuretic hormone) help regulate water balance?

options.text: It increases sweating to remove excess water
It increases the amount of water lost in urine
It causes more water to be reabsorbed by the kidneys

questions.explanation: ADH is released by the pituitary gland and acts on the kidneys to increase the reabsorption of water back into the blood. This produces more concentrated urine and helps maintain water balance.
